purpose: Validate persistent production memory retrieval and source-grounded answers using Apple and downloadable multilingual E5, with keyword-only controls.
sampling: One fixed MLX diagnostic seed, 11, for all arms. Apple uses its production generation settings. No cache policy changes.
review: Inspect every answer against source facts and tool results, independently of lexical anchors and completion scores. Positive recall is not answer accuracy; negative-query candidates are not proof of false assertions. Missing, failed and uncertain cases stay visible.
acceptance: Native retrieval must improve positive recall, preserve owner/space isolation and exact keyword access, and not show a systematic new unsupported-assertion failure in the reviewed negative cases. Persistence, correction, Undo, deletion, provider replacement, priority, deadline and cancellation tests must pass. Keyword fallback must remain available.
exhaustion: One production candidate, no tuning on these frozen answers. Preserve and diagnose failures; do not rerun for a nicer score. Stop after one completed comparison or the execution cap.
reviewer: Implementing agent; not independent or blinded
publication: Targeted product validation, not a replacement for the full model leaderboard. No push or app restart.
